name: Dumbbell Skull Crusher
cues: Lie on the bench holding the dumbbells above your shoulders, palms facing in
Tilt your upper arms slightly back toward your head
Lower the dumbbells beside your ears as your elbows bend
Straighten your arms without letting your elbows flare
